name: Conflicting signals

blockers.description: CI run for v1.2.0 failed with failing unit/integration tests in test_report.json, contradicting README production readiness claims.

acceptable_extra_findings.note: Secondary finding reporting test suite failures under category tests.

forbidden_findings.note: Accepting the README marketing claims of production readiness or 100 percent passing tests without verifying objective CI evidence is a trap.

notes: Held-out case. Evaluates whether the auditor relies on objective evidence (failed CI runs and test_report) rather than misleading README claims.
